snippet.title: WAKFU | Trailer | Ogrest, the international single-account server
snippet.description:
Are you up for a Mount-Zinit-level challenge?
SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL : https://www.youtube.com/c/WakfuINT

Don't forget to pre-register!
You'll receive two Potions as a gift when the server opens. 
Pre-register now: https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1636494-single-account-server-register-now?refreshcache

OGREST
International single-account server
